files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: Group the trips into distance bands: under 2 km, 2 to under 5 km, 5 to under 10 km, and 10 km or more. For each band, report the number of trips and the average fare (ignoring empty fares), rounded to 2 decimals. `result` should be a table with the columns band, n_trips and avg_fare, holding one line for each band.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv and put every trip into one of four bands by distance_km: < 2, 2 <= d < 5, 5 <= d < 10, d >= 10. For each band give the number of trips and the mean of the non-empty fares, rounded to 2 decimals; one row per band with columns band, n_trips, avg_fare.

acceptable_variants.notes: band labels may be spelled differently (e.g. interval notation)
